title: Dataset of emotion recognition using validated video stimuli with large-scale behavioral survey and MEG recordings
description: This dataset comprises magnetoencephalography (MEG) recordings from 23 participants viewing 40 validated emotional video stimuli, complemented by a large-scale behavioral survey of 500 participants rating the same stimuli. The dataset includes comprehensive phenotypic data with multi-faceted emotion assessments (Self-Assessment Manikin, discrete emotion categories, and temporal annotations), head digitization information for accurate source localization, and raw MEG signals. This resource enables investigation of emotion-specific neural signal patterns and brain-based emotion recognition.
methods_description: MEG recordings were acquired from 23 participants during viewing of 40 validated video clips designed to induce different emotional states. Emotional responses were assessed using multiple measures including Self-Assessment Manikin (SAM) for valence and arousal, discrete emotion categories (PrEmo), and temporal highlight scene selections. Head position information including 3D spatial coordinates of anatomical landmarks and Head Position Indicator (HPI) coils was digitized prior to each recording session for accurate co-registration.
